shape_order=[(4,3),(2,2),(3,2),(3,1),(6,2),(2,1),(4,2),(1,1)]

        pl_by_origin[(r,c)].append((sidx,s,bits,ori))
areas=tuple(s[0]*s[1] for s in shape_order)
@lru_cache(None)
def maxpack(processed, counts):
    rem=full & ~processed
    if not rem:
        return (0, ())
    first=(rem & -rem).bit_length()-1
    r,c=divmod(first,20)
    best=(-1,())
    # skip
    val,tail=maxpack(processed | (1<<first),counts)
    best=(val,tail)
    for si,s,bits,ori in pl_by_origin.get((r,c),[]):
        if counts[si]<=0 or bits&processed: continue
        cc=list(counts);cc[si]-=1
        val,tail=maxpack(processed|bits,tuple(cc))
        val+=areas[si]
        if val>best[0]: best=(val,((s,r,c,ori),)+tail)
